query:
WITH active_bot AS (
            SELECT team_id
            FROM bots
            WHERE id = $2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
        )
        SELECT cp.channel_id::text
        FROM active_bot
        JOIN comms_channel_participants cp
            ON cp.user_id = $1 AND cp.left_at IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT team_id::text
        FROM active_bot
        WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT $1
        FROM active_bot
